# spacypdfreader

> A PDF to text extraction pipeline component for spaCy.

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Functions
> The main entry point for converting a PDF into a spaCy Doc.

- [spacypdfreader.pdf_reader](https://samedwardes.github.io/spacypdfreader/reference/spacypdfreader.pdf_reader.html)

#### Parsers
> Built-in PDF-to-text parsers. Pass one of these to the `pdf_parser` argument of `pdf_reader`, or bring your own.

- [parsers.pdfminer.parser](https://samedwardes.github.io/spacypdfreader/reference/parsers.pdfminer.parser.html)
- [parsers.pytesseract.parser](https://samedwardes.github.io/spacypdfreader/reference/parsers.pytesseract.parser.html)
